title: Tax, Pricing & Checkout Calculation Specification
content: All customer orders in E-Automate are subject to a flat 10% sales tax (multiplier 1.10) and Free Shipping ($0.00). Order Total MUST equal round(subtotal * 1.10, 2). Any total less than subtotal (such as multiplying by 0.99) is a P1 regression in OrderController.createOrder.

title: Guest & Authenticated Shopping Cart Behavior
content: 1) Unauthenticated (guest) users clicking 'Add to Cart' on /products or /products/:id MUST see the destructive toast 'Authentication Required' and be redirected to /login?redirect=... (Working As Designed, NOT a bug). 2) Authenticated users clicking the trash icon (remove-item-{id}) or setting quantity <= 0 MUST immediately delete the row from cart_items in PostgreSQL.

title: Shipping Address & Optional Apartment/Suite Specification
content: On /checkout and POST /api/orders, Full Name (min 2), Address Line 1 (min 5), City (min 2), State (min 2), Postal Code (min 5), and Country (min 2) are required. Address Line 2 (Apartment, suite, etc.) is strictly OPTIONAL and may be null or omitted. Omitting line2 must never cause a 500 NullPointerException.

title: Signup Password Complexity & Payment Gateway Rules
content: Signup passwords require at least 12 characters, 1 uppercase letter, and 1 special character (Working As Designed). In MockPaymentGateway, cards ending in '0002' intentionally return HTTP 402 'Payment declined by issuer (card ending in 0002)' for testing decline flows (Working As Designed). Cards ending in '4242' succeed.

title: Inventory Stock Reservation & Order Cancellation Restoration
content: Placing an order atomically validates product.stock >= requested_quantity (returning HTTP 409 Conflict if insufficient) and decrements stock. If an ADMIN transitions an order status to 'cancelled', the backend restores the item quantities back to products.stock.
